threads.status: Round 3 (US-Mexico bilateral) concluded mid-August with progress on economic security, labor, steel/aluminum, autos. Round 4 agreed for September in Washington D.C. threads.label: FMCSA ADS NPRM (RIN 2126-AC17)
threads.status: NPRM projected for August 2026 — first comprehensive federal proposed rule for ADS-equipped commercial motor vehicles. Would address driver qualification equivalencies, drug/alcohol testing, CDL requirements, pre-trip inspection, and roadside inspection standards for driverless trucks. Not yet formally published as of August 6, 2026.

threads.label: Canada Section 338 Tariffs Aug 19
threads.status: Paused midnight Aug 19 — 3-day window through Aug 21 EOD to finalize deal. Trump calls framework 'very good for both countries.' Deal terms: US lowers tariffs on Canadian autos/steel/aluminum/forest products; Canada concedes on alcohol/dairy/procurement. If no deal by EOD Aug 21, 50% duties resume automatically.

threads.label: Iran-Oman Hormuz Shipping Deal
threads.status: 13 identified vessel crossings Aug 19-20 (vs. effectively zero prior weekend). US Navy has gained operational control; CNN reports Iran has 'lost significant control' of strait. AIS/GPS jamming ongoing — actual traffic may be higher. Brent crude ~$91. Recovery underway but far below pre-crisis 73 ships/day normal.

threads.label: Mexico World Trade Bridge Expansion
threads.status: Tamaulipas state announced expansion from 8 to 18 dedicated commercial lanes at World Trade Bridge Nuevo Laredo; construction set to begin H2 2026. USMCA Round 4 early September 2026 will determine rules-of-origin treatment affecting which goods flow through new capacity.

threads.label: CHR Nuclear Verdict Appeal
threads.status: C.H. Robinson appealing $604M Texas nuclear verdict. CEO Bozeman publicly stated he 'expects to prevail on appeal' (Aug 13). Preliminary 2027 insurance renewal discussions started; covered through 2026. Appeal process 'could take years.' Stock down ~20% since verdict. RXO running active enterprise sales campaign targeting same accounts. Industry carrier-vetting documentation overhaul underway.

threads.label: Trimble TMS/TMW Sale Process
threads.status: CEO Rob Painter formally confirmed at Q2 2026 earnings call that Trimble is evaluating sale of T&L unit (TMW TMS, Transporeon, PCMiler); Goldman Sachs advising; multiple unsolicited buyer inquiries received; no buyer named as of August 14. Q4 TMS contract renewal cycle now open — active Transplace displacement window.

threads.label: Daimler Truck NA Greenfield US Plant
threads.status: Supervisory board approved largest-ever Daimler greenfield US truck manufacturing plant. Construction starts late 2026, production target 2029, supporting vocational and on-highway trucks including electric and autonomous-ready configurations. Near-term rate cycle through 2028 remains structurally tight.

threads.label: Uber Freight Helix Data Breach
threads.status: Helix extortion group (Google Mandiant UNC6671) claims ~1M files exfiltrated from Uber Freight including dispatch docs, AR/AP data, mailbox archives, OneDrive files. UF confirmed incident 'identified, contained, remediated' with federal law enforcement engaged August 12, 2026. Has not disclosed whether shipper pricing or carrier contract data exposed. Investigation ongoing.
